verdict.rationale: Zero calls itself an "open-source AI email solution". Its own MCP docs list AI capabilities over the user's mail: asking questions about mailbox content, asking about specific threads, and AI-assisted composing. That counts as AI-generated insight and suggestions from the user's data. However, the evidence is a bare tool list in the MCP server doc, so it is unclear how much of this surfaces in the product's own UI rather than through a connected agent. missing for 10: evidence of in-app insight features (e.g. summaries or proactive suggestions in the inbox UI), depth of the Q&A capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
